# C++ Faithful Atomic Output Template

Use this structure for every generated `artifacts/binary-discovery/<domain>/<AtomicName>.cpp` file.
Code does **NOT** need to compile standalone — preserve exact decompiled types, member names, formulas, and `UNRESOLVED_BINARY_REF` markers without inventing missing headers or guessed stubs.

```cpp
// <auto-generated>
// Binary: server1/jx_linux_y
// Function: <ClassName::MethodName> @ <0xAddress>
// AtomicId: <domain.sub.atomic_name>
// Note: Faithful binary reconstruction (not standalone-compilable; source of truth = decompile).
// </auto-generated>

/**
 * Binary Evidence: server1/jx_linux_y | <ClassName::MethodName> @ <0xAddress>
 * Summary: <Concise description strictly from decompiled code.>
 */
<ReturnType> <ClassName>::<MethodName>(/* exact parameters from DWARF/decompile */)
{
    // Exact preconditions, integer arithmetic, bitmasks, branches, and clamps from decompile.
    // For any un-decompiled callee or untraced offset:
    // UNRESOLVED_BINARY_REF: <CalleeName> @ <0xAddr>
}
```
